text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Such a nice tune... Thank you for the
present,
Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Music is like a wind that stirs my heart. It
feels
good in a way that's different from
running.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome... But you really like it?
All I did
was play the piano as my
present.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm not good enough to call that a gift...
Maybe I
should go out and get you a
real present.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No, your rhythmic tones are always like
an
easterly wind that gently brushes
through
budding flowers...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've had your wind blow over
me, I feel
like I can bloom into my full
glory.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Easterly wind... Um, the wind in spring?
That must
be a compliment. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Speaking in terms like that, I like your
tones as
well, Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The way you play the trumpet so clearly
is
refreshing. How do I say it... Yes, it's
like a breeze
in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A morning breeze... Really? I'm so happy
to be
spoken of that way.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Miracle, in that case, would you let me
celebrate
your birthday with my morning
breeze?
